pairs: Mensis etiam septimi prima dies venerabilis et sancta erit vobis.
“Now the first day of the seventh month also shall be venerable and holy to you.
Omne opus servile non facietis in ea,
In it, you shall not do any servile work,
quia dies clangoris est et tubarum.
because it is the day of the sounding of the trumpets.
Offeretisque holocaustum in odorem suavissimum Domino,
And you shall offer a holocaust, as a most sweet odor to the Lord:
arietem unum, et agnos anniculos immaculatos septem:
one ram, and seven immaculate one-year-old lambs;
similæ oleo conspersæ tres decimas per singulos vitulos,
fine wheat flour sprinkled with oil: three tenths for each calf,
which all together are seven lambs;
which is offered as an expiation for the people,
præter holocaustum calendarum cum sacrificiis suis, et holocaustum sempiternum cum libationibus solitis:
aside from the holocaust of the first day of the month with its sacrifices, and the perpetual holocaust with the usual libations.
eisdem cæremoniis offeretis in odorem suavissimum incensum Domino.

the tenth day of this seventh month shall be for you holy and venerable,

omne opus servile non facietis in ea,
you shall not do any servile work in it,
sed celebrabitis solemnitatem Domino septem diebus.
but you shall celebrate a solemnity to the Lord for seven days.

And you shall offer a holocaust, as a most sweet odor to the Lord:
similæ oleo conspersæ tres decimas per vitulos singulos,
